entities.name: PMID:37108353
observations: WGBS of leg muscle from two goose breeds across embryonic day 15, embryonic day 23, and post-hatch day 1 found negative correlations between gene expression and methylation around transcription start sites, but positive correlations in gene bodies near transcription termination sites.

Earlier demethylation of the MyoD1 promoter was associated with earlier expression in one breed; the study supports distinct promoter-repressive and gene-body-positive associations but does not establish causality for all loci.

entities.name: Complementary methylation roles
observations: In a multi-sample WGBS and transcriptome study, methylation near transcription start sites was inversely related to expression, whereas gene-body methylation near transcription termination sites was positively related to expression.

entities.name: MyoD1
observations: Earlier promoter demethylation was associated with earlier MyoD1 expression during goose embryonic muscle development in the WGBS study PMID:37108353.
